body:
I think, i found the problem (but not the solution), i wanted to send you the file and the profile, but that is no more needed:

the picture on the left **had no more profile .arp.** This is missing in the folder. The settings in ART were correct, the different modules were correct activated. I had to restart the pc, restart ART, delete the picture from the queue. The rest worked.

I switched one single module off and on again and the profile was there (again or for the first time)! The picture is now exported.

The question is: why was there no profile for this picture in the folder while ART shows the correct settings from the profile ... 
i will check this if it happens again. This was not the first time. Because export needs much time, i fill the queue with a batch of many files, often 50 or more.

My workflow is always:

- load the folder
- mark all
- set a profile to all
- make the geometric corrections
- send all pictures to the queue which starts then automatically
